Part 6 · Miao Silver Shop
⭐ 0

🏪 Welcome to Miao Silver Gallery

On the left are our treasures: a Miao silver headdress（银冠）and a silver necklace（银项圈）with butterflies（蝴蝶）and little bells（铃铛）— all handcrafted by Miao artisans.
You are the shop assistant（店员）. A foreign customer walks in — first fill the sales patterns, then sell the jewelry in English, for 45–60 seconds!

📖 Facts
Miao silver jewelry（苗族银饰）is handcrafted（手工制作）by Miao artisans（手艺人）.
Artisans use filigree（花丝）and inlay（镶嵌）techniques.
Silver jewelry symbolizes（象征）prosperity（富足）and protection（护佑）.
It is an important part of traditional Miao culture and a symbol of ethnic identity（民族身份）.
Today, artisans inherit（传承）the craftsmanship（工艺）and promote（推广）it on the global stage.
苗族银饰由苗族匠人手工制作。
匠人使用花丝与镶嵌工艺。
银饰象征富足与护佑。
它是苗族传统文化的重要组成部分，也是民族身份的象征。
今天，匠人传承这门手艺，并把它推广到世界舞台。
